findings.summary: A held commit is pushed without its GO when git's commit cleanup rewrites the message the writer composed. commit_recursive.sh (and integrate_merge.sh) run 'git commit -F' without --cleanup=verbatim and never read the committed message back. With the owner's global config commit.cleanup=strip and core.commentChar=A (global config is trusted by design, verify_repos.sh:94; the CPA env belt pins 7 keys, not these), the Awaits-Review line is stripped as a comment, commit_recursive still prints 'COMMIT ... ev/reviews/v.json' rc=0 and writes the commits.tsv row, and push_recursive prints 'PUSHED . origin 66c301ab...' to a local bare remote. commentChar=D strips Deferred-Gates the same way (a deferred gate silently disappears). Same class as R-01 (the bytes the readers parse are not the bytes the writer intended): one parser is not enough while a transformer sits between writer and object.
findings.repro: scratch only: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=<file with commit.cleanup=strip, core.commentChar=A>; commit_recursive.sh --held-from <g.txt -> ev/reviews/v.json>; push_recursive.sh --main-root . --branch main --run-dir <aud>/<rid> -> PUSHED of the held commit

R-03 still open: no kcov run of the matrix in IMG-KCOV for these bytes (fix-r6-kcov.txt BLOCKED). Cause found by the fixer and confirmed by reading: scripts/longops/lib.sh lo_pid_ok requires pgid > 1, so a lock holder whose process group is 1 (a container's PID 1 session) is refused -> lock_error. This is a 11.4.201(1) false refusal: 11.4.263 forbids SIGNALLING pgid <= 1, and lo_signal/lo_kill_child already guard the signal itself and only ever signal a single pid; refusing to REGISTER such a pid buys no safety. Fix in longops (registration may accept pgid 1; the signal guard stays). Owed T044 evidence; not on its own a GO blocker for the hold logic, but T044 acceptance is unmet.

The 'one parser' has one byte-level exception: cpa_foreign_listed maps 0x1e to '?' before parsing, so a block holding 0x1e is malformed (status 3) for cpa_trailer but parses as status 0 for cpa_foreign_listed and its Foreign-Commit lines count (probe: foreign=0 vs trl=3). Also cpa_foreign_listed counts Foreign-Commit lines of ANY reachable commit, CPA or not. Impact bounded (Foreign-Commit is audit data; the malformed commit itself is not a CPA commit). Fix: treat a message containing 0x1e as malformed in cpa_foreign_listed too, or split without rewriting bytes.

Asymmetric near-miss handling: a reserved key BEFORE the block is matched case-insensitively with blanks allowed (MALFORMED), but INSIDE the block 'awaits-review: v', 'Awaits-Review : v', 'Awaits-Review:v' and 'Awaits-Review:<NBSP>v' are silently ignored as attribution text (not held, status 0), while git interpret-trailers reads them as holds; mixed-case duplicates are not detected. Not reachable through the writer today, but it is exactly the fail-open the F-01 class needs. Fix: inside the block, a line whose case-folded key, blanks stripped, is reserved but is not the exact spelling is MALFORMED.
